authority.evaluator: An independent custodian must protect evaluator, preregistration, held-out data and acceptance authority before future native evaluation.

numerical.reason: No native inference implementation, checkpoint or numerical reference exists. A preregistered plan requires a hashed reference source, per-operator dtype atol/rtol with finite checks, fixed teacher-forced history for logits/probabilities, greedy agreement and declared deterministic replay conditions.

held_out.reason: No independent held-out workload is enrolled. A preregistered plan requires a workload ID/hash, independent custodian and access policy withholding content from candidate training, selection and modification authority. Public examples are fixtures.

performance.reason: No Tessryn performance is measured. Before running, register target/warmup sample counts, observation duration, arrival process/offered load, concurrency/admission budgets, prompt/output/tenant distributions, cache state, latency SLOs, sustained thermal duration, ambient temperature, power/frequency policy and exact candidate/evaluator/platform/model identities. Report raw results and request outcome counts even when gates fail.
